faq.q: What is the origin of Amran?
faq.a: Amran is associated with Arabic. ʿImrān, the father of Maryam in Islamic tradition; also the name of the third sura of the Qur'an.
Yes — the underlying form عمران is Arabic.
Amran can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
